Class TimeSlotController

java.lang.Object
handlers.TimeSlotController
public class TimeSlotController extends Object
Controller responsible for displaying and managing available time slots for creating a new reservation.

This controller:

  • Receives reservation details from the previous screen
  • Requests available time slots from the server
  • Displays selectable time slots to the user
  • Handles reservation creation upon time selection
